steps.query: Query all FIFA World Cup matches where England was one of the teams. Return the match identifier and the names of the two teams.

extra.sql_query: SELECT COUNT(*) AS amount FROM matches INNER JOIN teams t1 ON t1.team = matches.team1 INNER JOIN teams t2 ON t2.team = matches.team2 WHERE t1.name = 'England men''s national association football team' OR t2.name = 'England men''s national association football team'

s1.sql_query: SELECT teams.team, teams.name FROM teams WHERE teams.name = 'England men''s national association football team'
